text:
deploy-bot: kicking off CONFIG-ONLY rollout r-2026-04-slim-tune (id:r-2026-04-slim-tune). Scope: routing heuristic + batching/window + soft tenant limits. Canary: 1% for 8m.
deploy-bot: diff:
```
- routing_selector: round_robin -> prefer-healthy-az
- tenant_soft_limit: 60r/s -> 45r/s (soft-limit flag)
- batching.window_ms: 15 -> 9
- client_idle_timeout_ms: 900 -> 820
```
Sasha (PM): Heads-up to support: this is non-functional change, perf tuning only. Will post RN after canary. RN ref: RN-2026-04-01-slimtune
Alex (oncall): I'm on watch for the first 20m. Abort criteria: error-rate +3% sustained 4m OR tail latency p99 +120ms.
Lina: confirming autoscaler and node pools unaffected. infra-bot will notify if any host OOM/GC spike.
infra-bot: infra-health: no recent flapping in target clusters (us-central1, eu-west1).
obs-bot: Canary started @1698765432. Links: dashboard https://dashboards.internal/r/rollouts/r-2026-04-slim-tune logs https://logs.internal/q/r-2026-04-slim-tune
Karan: saw tiny p95 +8ms at t+2m, but stable. watching kv-cache hit ratio since batch reduction is notable.
Lina: added a short trace filter for tenants with legacy-prefix to watch prefix-load.
Alex (oncall): noticed p99 bump +90ms at t+4m localized to eu-west1 host pool. Flagging.
Karan: we have a temporary increase in KV miss rate for a subset. Guess: fewer ops per batch => more cache churn.
Sasha (PM): prefer scoped rollback rather than full if it's isolated. Any quick flags to flip?
Lina: we have a per-tenant limiter flag (soft-limit-v3) and a routing pin flag (routing-az-toggle). We can unflag soft-limit-v3 for tenants with tag "legacy-prefix" quickly.
Alex (oncall): proceed with scoped unflag for legacy-prefix. Keep batch/window change global. If that fixes p99 in 3m, continue ramp.
deploy-bot: executing scoped unflag soft-limit-v3 for tenant-tag legacy-prefix -> expected propagation ~30s.
obs-bot: Scoped change applied. Monitoring tail latencies and error counts.
Karan: post-scope revert p99 for affected tenants dropped back to baseline within 90s. Global metrics unchanged.
Alex (oncall): no errors or pagers. thumbs-up. Ready to continue ramp to 30% over 6m.
deploy-bot: ramping to 30% now.
obs-bot: ramp progress: 1% -> 30%.
Lina: during ramp we saw one tenant with CPU spike on a node, unrelated to rollout, caused by their synthetic workload. Took them offline, stabilized.
Sasha (PM): logging note: scoped revert for legacy-prefix. Plan follow-up: run a 48h microcanary for legacy-prefix with batch/window change disabled before reintroducing soft-limit-v3.
Karan: opening follow-up ticket ISSUE-4398: automate warmup detection + suggested tenant-scoped exceptions for KV-warmup. Link: https://tracker.internal/ISSUE-4398
deploy-bot: ramp to 100% scheduled in 15m windows. Proceeding to 100% in 3 steps.
obs-bot: Rollout finished at 1698765495. Summary: successful. Final metrics: global error-rate delta +0.05%, p95 +9ms, p99 +22ms.
Alex (oncall): closing watch at +1h. No ongoing issues.
Sasha (PM): RN RN-2026-04-01-slimtune updated: changes: AZ-aware routing preference, batch window 15->9ms, client timeout 900->820ms, scoped soft-limit revert for legacy-prefix. Follow-ups: ISSUE-4398 and 48h microcanary for legacy-prefix.
Lina: will add a short alert to detect KV warmup regressions on future batch-window reductions.
deploy-bot: rollout complete status: success :white_check_mark:
Sasha (PM): thanks all :party_popper:
